heading: Definitions

tree.text: The term “program” means the Defense Civilian Training Corps program established under section 2200g.
The term “member of the program” means a student at an accredited civilian educational institution who is enrolled in the program.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2021—Pub. L. 116–283 substituted “§” for “SEC.” in section designation.
